d.ko: When dinosaurs were brought back to life, none wanted to be a cop, so humans made you: Dinocop. Investigate the guests of the Cretaceous hotel to crack a meaty case that will confront you with your most profound existential dilemma. Who brought human meat to the dinosaur rights convention ?
d.en: When dinosaurs were brought back to life, none wanted to be a cop, so humans made you: Dinocop. Investigate the guests of the Cretaceous hotel to crack a meaty case that will confront you with your most profound existential dilemma. Who brought human meat to the dinosaur rights convention ?
d.zh: 恐龙在复活之后，没有一只愿意当警察，所以人类创造了你：恐龙警探。你将调查白垩纪酒店的宾客，侦破人肉案件，直面内心深处最根本存在困境。到底是谁把人肉带进了恐龙权利大会？
